messages:
alice: Quick sync 2:00 UTC change window: API 2.14.0, Runtime 3.7.2, Console v2026.03.02, Router header-split 1.12.5. Need pins, deploybot wave, rollback triggers. Blockers?
ben: Runtime ready but adding one last patch; I'll pin 3.7.2 and run a short staging canary. No DB migrations.
carla: Console hotfix ready. Release notes draft here: https://redwood/release-notes/console-v2026.03.02-draft. Console depends on API /session. If we fallback to 2.13 console will error.
dinesh: Router plan: enable `x-rw-experimental` only on canary slices. Traffic plan 5% -> 25% -> manual 100%. Will drain kv cache TTL on canary nodes. Quick rollback = flip flag off + route to `router:stable`.
ben: @deploybot create wave: sequence router -> runtime -> api -> console. 5min observation per step, manual approve to continue. Keep 2.13 in fallback pool.
deploybot: Wave created: 1717777777-w1. Sequence: router, runtime, api, console. Canary slices: 5% then 25%. Observers: @oncall-eve. Cancel: `/deploy cancel 1717777777-w1`.
oncall-eve: I'll monitor. Telemetry: p50, p95, 5xx, schema errors, kv miss rate. Rollback if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 +30% sustained 10m.
carla: Add schema guard for /session: any validation failure in canary blocks rollout.
ben: Setting `runtime.kv_evict_threshold=0.6` for canary to avoid eviction spikes we saw in staging. Adding warmup step.
dinesh: Router revert path reiterated: flip header flag off and backfill stable tag; should be fast and isolate impact.
alice: I'll update release notes with compatibility section and embed Grafana links + runbook.
carla: Confirmed no DB migrations.
ben: Pins pushed: runtime=3.7.2, api=2.14.0, console=v2026.03.02, router=1.12.5-header-split
deploybot: Pins applied, wave 1717777777-w1 scheduled. Updates will appear in channel during rollout.
alice: Thanks team. Ping me or @oncall-eve for anomalies. Proceed as planned. :rocket:
